{{Quote|It's only a light cruiser&hellip; not in the full Star-Destroyer class!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="SW18:TES" />}}
The '''''Enforcement''''' was a [[Pursuit-class light cruiser|''Pursuit''-class light cruiser]] which served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] served as the lead for the fleet of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]], whilst he was stationed as guardian of the Imperial-free zone surrounding [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].
